rationale: P identifies the vehicle braking behaviour that must be characterised to evaluate prevention of unintended braking under SG-3. Its operational scope and sudden-stop event are directly supported by H-3. Braking behaviour is itself the subject of evaluation, not merely a control mechanism affecting another phenomenon. P does not incorporate sensing, computation, communication, failure-mitigation mechanisms, or their timing constraints.
determining_elements: The vehicle's braking behaviour, including whether braking occurs without an obstacle in front of the ego vehicle.
The scope of straight-ahead driving on a less frequented urban road at 50 km/h in good weather, with no visible obstacles or vehicles ahead, matches H-3's operational situation.
The vehicle suddenly stopping despite no obstacle ahead matches H-3's hazardous event; this temporal behaviour belongs to the braking phenomenon itself.
